task.description:
WF-03 Step 3: Implement the fix per the validated design.

Read src/design/iss0209-test-api08-recovery.md and implement EXACTLY what it specifies:

1. tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig:57-96 — remove DROP SCHEMA CASCADE recovery branch, wrap canonical provisionTenantSchema in the same advisory lock, retry-on-transient (55P03/40P01), escalate-on-persistent (RecoveryFailed).
2. src/db/provisioning.zig:73-118 — expose advisoryLockKeyPrefix + acquireAdvisoryLock/releaseAdvisoryLock helpers (defence-in-depth).

Then validate:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exits 0 (no BLOCKER/MAJOR)
- zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' (no output)

Self-review checklist (per BACKEND-DEV section of CLAUDE.md):
- No SQL string interpolation
- All allocating funcs take std.mem.Allocator
- src/engine/transition.zig zero I/O if modified
- Error types in per-module error sets
- No mocks/stubs/fakes in tests
- No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests
- Integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL

After implementation: commit to feature branch (NOT main), push to origin, complete handoff.
acceptance_criteria: No 'error set' in zig build stderr
Changes committed to feature branch and pushed

result.summary: Implemented ISS-0209/GH-533 fix per validated design. tests/unit/test_api08_auth.zig now uses a non-destructive ensureTenantDefaultSchema: same advisory lock key as canonical provisionTenantSchema, retry-on-transient (MigrationFailed) with bounded exponential backoff, escalate-on-persistent (HarnessRecoveryError.RecoveryFailed). src/db/provisioning.zig exposes advisoryLockKeyPrefix + acquireAdvisoryLock/releaseAdvisoryLock as defence-in-depth; canonical provisionTenantSchema() was refactored to use the same helpers (no behaviour change for existing callers). zig build: 0 errors, 0 error-set leaks. python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests: 0 BLOCKER / 0 MAJOR / 0 MINOR. python tools/lint_handoffs.py: clean for this run after stripping an inherited UTF-8 BOM. zig build test compiles cleanly; 918/1003 passing with 64 skipped and 21 failed — exact match to the pre-existing baseline documented in docs/issue-reports/ISS-0209-diagnosis.yaml (16 TC-PD-07-* definition_retrieval_test + 5 TC-IDN-* test_api08_auth, all surfacing as PgError.AuthenticationFailed from pg.zig's SCRAM handshake against the trust-mode bpm_test container; pre-existing test-infrastructure defect, not a regression introduced by this change). Full inner report at docs/issue-reports/WF03-GH533-20260807-step-03-backend-dev-INNER-REPORT.yaml.

issues.description: Pre-existing 21-test failure baseline (16 TC-PD-07-* + 5 TC-IDN-*) reproduced exactly under BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test. Failure mode is PgError.AuthenticationFailed from pg.zig's handleScram against the trust-mode bpm_test container — outside the scope of this fix (the diagnosis documents the same 21 failures surfacing as C42P01 here; root cause is pg.zig SCRAM incompatibility with the local test container, unrelated to the destructive-recovery race). Compilation of every modified file succeeds; the new code path is NOT the cause of these failures (failures occur at Pool.init before any lock acquire runs).
H008 BOM inherited from a prior session's PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 on this handoff file. Stripped in this run; lint now clean for the current run.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 5) for end-to-end validation against BPM_TEST_DB_URL per design §9.1 + §9.3 (run zig build test --summary all five times to verify the destructive-recovery race is closed in practice; add tests/integration/iss0209_tenant_default_recovery_race_test.zig with the 5 regression tests specified in the design).
